# AMH Future Site Kits — Collection 02

Three original local-only foundation kits, built as fictional internal design concepts:

- **EMBERLINE / restaurant:** theatrical burgundy, coral and parchment; evening-dining composition with menu filtering.
- **LIFTWORKS / home service:** industrial blue, white and safety orange; garage-door illustration and service-preparation selector.
- **MUSE / INDEX / lifestyle creator:** powder-blue, cherry-red magazine-style lookbook; editorial filters and details.

These are not real businesses or commissioned identities. No names are trademark-cleared. No customer reviews, addresses, follower counts, client results, contact endpoints, bookings or payment handles are asserted.

## Use locally

Extract the complete ZIP and open `index.html` to search and browse the kits. Each folder's `index.html` works independently. Native HTML/CSS/JS, relative paths, local SVG art and system fonts mean no package installation, API keys or network are needed. If local file restrictions apply, use a trusted static server such as `python -m http.server 8000` and its localhost URL.

Each kit includes its own README and configuration metadata. Configuration files are editorial handoffs, **not a runtime CMS**. Edit the HTML copy, CSS visual tokens, JavaScript data and SVG assets intentionally; changes to JSON do not automatically rewrite the page.

## Package guide

- `index.html`, `index.css`, `index.js`: searchable collection.
- `restaurant/`, `home-service/`, `lifestyle/`: self-contained kits.
- `manifest.json`: collection, assets and intended destinations.
- `build-log.json`, `build-log.csv`: file inventory, SHA-256 hashes and asset provenance.
- `qa-report.md`, `qa-results.json`: exact completed checks and known limits.
- `previews/`: captured local desktop/mobile previews.
- `tools/check.py`: repeatable structural checks (Python 3 plus Node for JS syntax).

## Before publication

1. Verify the business or creator, name rights and all content with the owner.
2. Replace illustrative menu/service/portfolio copy with approved factual content. SVG images are art studies, not photos of actual meals, installations or client work.
3. Review any dietary/allergen/menu information with the actual restaurant. The home-service checklist is an intake-content example, not an instruction to repair high-tension garage components. Do not add unsafe DIY guidance.
4. Add only confirmed contact, booking, ordering or social destinations when authorized; do not invent working forms or results.
5. Replace/approve imagery, alt text, metadata, policies and content. Obtain appropriate privacy/legal review for the real site.
6. Re-test responsive layouts, keyboard operation, contrast, filters, disclosures and dialogs after editing.
7. Obtain separate publication authorization. Keep preview `noindex` until then. `noindex` is not access control.

## Asset provenance

All SVG marks and illustrations are original code-native geometric artwork authored for this collection. No stock photographs, external fonts, copied logos or generated raster art are used. Screenshots are local QA evidence, not promotional photos. Logo canvases are transparent; favicons may include their intentional icon backgrounds. Reuse and adapt the originals, but independently clear names/marks and outline approved font-based wordmarks before print production.

## Storage truth

Created in the cloud workspace `/workspace/shared/future-site-kits-20261029-collection02`.
Intended destination: `D:\AMH\FutureSiteKits\2026-10-29-collection-02`.
**No D: transfer was performed.** Drive and Git delivery are separate parent-task steps and remain pending in this package. Nothing is published. Collection 01, Dylan and WALO were not modified.

This is a finite second collection of three foundation kits, not an ongoing generation service or completed real-business launch.

# EMBERLINE — Restaurant concept / AMH Collection 02

**Internal fictional design preview. Not an operating restaurant.** All dish titles are creative writing examples, not available dishes, ingredient declarations or dietary advice. There are no prices, reviews, venue claims, reservation or contact forms.

## Run
Open index.html directly or serve this folder with `python3 -m http.server 8000`. No build, dependencies, external requests, analytics, cookies or collection of personal information.

## Design
Theatrical evening dining in burgundy, coral and parchment. Oversized serif editorial typography, panoramic overhead table illustration, ingredient still life, a menu-board filtering interface and accessible native detail dialog. This is deliberately not a cafe layout.

## Working behavior
- Responsive mobile navigation; Escape and selected links close it.
- Four menu category filters update visible studies and live status.
- Six dish-note triggers open a native modal dialog; Close, Back and Escape dismiss it. Native modal keyboard containment and explicit return focus to the trigger.
- Native pre-publication disclosure, local section links and setup guide.
- Visible keyboard focus, reduced motion and safe-area footer padding.

## Replace before publishing
1. Verify the real restaurant name, ownership, address and hours. Concept name is not trademark-cleared.
2. Replace narrative and illustrative dish names with client-approved accurate content. Verify actual ingredient/allergen and dietary information with the restaurant; never infer it from example titles.
3. Add actual prices, reservations, maps or contact details only when supplied and verified. No default fake destination is provided.
4. Review image licensing, privacy requirements and accessibility. Retain meaningful image alt descriptions; illustrations are not venue/food photography.
5. Add verified destination URLs and test them. Remove fictional-preview notices and noindex only with publication approval.

## Original vector assets
- `assets/logo.svg`: transparent custom geometric EMBERLINE wordmark; glyph paths authored for this kit.
- `assets/favicon.svg`: original circular E symbol.
- `assets/table.svg`: original overhead dining-table illustration.
- `assets/flame.svg`: original ribbon-flame illustration.
- `assets/ingredients.svg`: original ingredient still life.
All created in SVG source on 2026-10-29. No stock, scraped images, image generation or third-party fonts. System Georgia/Arial used in the page. Edit vector paths/colors directly; the logo has no font dependency.

## Delivery and QA
Local cloud source only, not deployed or saved to D:. Intended future destination: `D:/AMH/FutureSiteKits/collection02/restaurant`.
Static validation: JS syntax; all local HTML links/assets and IDs; all SVG XML; config JSON. Parent handles supported browser QA separately; consult collection build log for actual browser results.

Open `index.html` directly or serve the folder with `python3 -m http.server 8080`. No dependencies, remote fonts, analytics, external images or build step. Without JavaScript, navigation, FAQ and the default checklist remain readable; project switching requires JavaScript.

## Design and features
Industrial blue/white with restrained safety-orange accents. Technical illustration-led split hero, precise service cards, tailored project information checklists, native FAQ details, responsive mobile menu with Escape/focus return, reduced-motion support and safe-area padding. Unlike the editorial café kit, this uses compact sans-serif typography and a practical service architecture.

The planner displays information to gather; it does not diagnose, advise repair, calculate a price, save personal information or submit enquiries. No component adjustment instructions are provided.

## Before publication
- Clear the approved real business name; replace logo, title, metadata and all placeholder text.
- Confirm service scope, area, credentials and claims with the owner. This kit asserts none.
- Add only verified contact/booking routes, policies and hours when approved. Do not imply emergency coverage unless verified.
- Replace sample process and FAQs with accurate operational details.
- Have the owner or appropriate specialist approve service/safety wording.
- Add approved product information and rights-cleared photographs where useful.
- Review accessibility, privacy and applicable business requirements.
- Remove preview disclosures and `noindex` only after explicit publication authorization and content approval.
- Test navigation, keyboard operation, checklist variants and FAQs on target devices.

## Files
`index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js`; original SVG assets `logo.svg`, `favicon.svg`, `garage.svg`, `door.svg`, `drive.svg`, `inspection.svg`; handoff `config.json`.

All assets are original code-native vectors created for this kit. Logo/favicon backgrounds are transparent. Logo uses system-font lettering: convert to paths after brand approval for an invariant master. Illustrations are decorative concepts, not engineering drawings or equipment instructions. `config.json` is a handoff manifest, not a CMS; edit HTML directly.
